dimensions.note: Role credentials are optional sensitive global arguments; no secret values are logged or persisted.
Every method emits structured entry and completion logs without object keys or credentials; exact candidate outcomes are durably plan-bound.
Isolation accepts only AccessDenied, list and immutable-write anomalies fail closed, and destructive confirmation is exact and digest-bound.

Fifteen model and contract tests pass, including pagination, lifecycle, schema writes, and crash recovery. The exact generic implementation could not complete a live R2 canary because this runner cannot read the operations vault; the older private model's successful run is not treated as equivalent evidence.
Create-once plans, ledgers, per-candidate intents/outcomes, and receipts make replay deterministic; interrupted deletes become explicit uncertainty rather than false deletion claims.
AWS SDK pagination, lifecycle, conditional-write, HEAD, and delete behavior are covered with command fakes, but the exact implementation has not completed a live R2 canary due vault permissions.
Listings are bounded and all constructed S3 clients are destroyed in finally blocks.
Published arguments, resources, plans, receipts, intents, and outcomes use strict schemas.

Swamp resources have bounded GC, while provider ledgers and plans intentionally remain append-only and can eventually reach maximumObjects; operators must choose a bound appropriate to their retention horizon.
Safety protocol model, not a CRUD resource lifecycle.
Apply has separately visible policy and live-authority checks and repeats destructive invariants inside execution.
Provider state is read through explicit immutable S3 objects; model methods do not bypass Swamp data APIs for Swamp resources.
